QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_27

question.text: As per SEBI rules, if the AIF is established as a TRUST, then losses/damages/expenses incurred by the Manager or its officers in relation to resolution of investor claims/disputes:

answer.text: Shall be met out of the trust property
Shall NOT be met out of the trust property
Shall be passed on to distributors

explanation.text: The Logic: If the AIF has been established as a trust, no loss, damage or expense incurred by the Manager or its officers, including those in relation to resolution of investor claims/disputes, shall be met out of the trust property. This protects the corpus. The Trap: 'Met out of trust property' is the common trap — it is the opposite of the rule. SEBI refund and distributor-pass-through options are absurd. Note: Page 284 of the workbook codifies this trust-property protection rule.
